tasks.title: AGENTS.md (distilled working rules) + README.md (honest current-state statement)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: README states plainly that no real map is imported and no Unity build exists yet; AGENTS.md captures no-fake-data, three-layer separation, evidence, and human-approval rules.

tasks.title: Bounded dotnet-sdk-8.0 apt experiment (for wave-3 dotnet test readiness)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Single timeboxed apt-get install attempt, real outcome recorded either way, no PPAs added, no other system-wide installs.

tasks.title: Implement `thaivia acquire`: real bounded OSM extract against configs/sources.json, honoring acquire_budget
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Downloads a bounded extract (not a country-sized file) within max_download_bytes/timeout/retry budget, honors 429/Retry-After, freezes response as a hashed local fixture; asks for human approval above require_human_approval_above_bytes.
tasks.notes: --from-url (network) is fully implemented (budget cap, connect/read timeouts, retries with backoff, Retry-After, byte-limit abort, streaming SHA-256) and fails HONESTLY and IMMEDIATELY against every allowed endpoint, which is all policy-blocked (see docs/decisions/0003); it never retries a block and never falls back to synthetic data. --from-local-file (offline) is fully implemented and genuinely exercised end to end. Real pilot-area network acquisition itself is STILL BLOCKED -- this task is 'code done + tested', not 'real th-bkk-pilot-001 data acquired' (that remains G1-10's blocker).

tasks.title: Source lock: URL, retrieval time, source snapshot time (or unknown reason), SHA-256, importer/settings version
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable lock file is written alongside the cached source and referenced by the eventual MapPack manifest.
tasks.notes: Content-addressed by (sha256, settings_hash); immutable once written (a settings change writes a NEW file, never overwrites an old one -- see ADR-0007). Includes source_snapshot_unknown_reason when a snapshot timestamp is not derivable, per spec.

tasks.title: Entity parse: nodes/ways/relations with references (not display-GeoJSON-only)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Parser builds the graph from raw OSM entities and references, not from a flattened GeoJSON export; complete_ways vs complete_relations handled explicitly.
tasks.notes: osm_parse.py builds OsmDataset directly from osmium node/way/relation callbacks; explicitly documents and handles complete_ways != complete relations (features.py reports incomplete relations rather than dropping them).

tasks.title: Project/normalize: WGS84 lon/lat -> AOI-appropriate projected CRS -> local origin, always_xy
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Round-trip error <=0.10 m; no lon/lat swap; no raw-degrees-as-meters; CRS choice not hardcoded across all of Thailand.
tasks.notes: Measured (not asserted) round-trip error on the pilot bbox after 1cm quantization is ~5.9mm max, well under the 0.10m budget. CRS is a per-AOI config value validated against the AOI's own UTM zone/hemisphere (ADR-0005), never hardcoded.

tasks.title: Topology validation: multipolygon holes, missing references, building parts, duplicate POI/building associations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Holes/multipart features do not become duplicate buildings; unsupported cases land in a report, not a silent drop.
tasks.notes: features.py assembles multipolygon holes and multi-part (several outer rings) correctly, keeps building:part as its own feature class (never duplicated), and flags duplicate POI<->building tag associations without dropping either feature.

tasks.title: Semantic RoadGraph builder: oneway (incl. -1), access/modes, bridge/tunnel/layer, turn restrictions, grade separation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Crossing polylines at different layers never become an intersection; oneway=-1 and turn restrictions survive; unsupported restriction types are reported, not silently dropped.
tasks.notes: Junctions are computed purely from shared OSM node references (graph.py never imports shapely, enforced by an AST-level test); a bridge crossing a road at layer=1 with no shared node stays disconnected while a genuinely shared node connects. oneway=-1 -> 'reversed'; junction=roundabout implies forward. Turn restrictions with a via-way (complex) or unrecognized type are marked unsupported and land in the quality report, never silently dropped.

tasks.title: Editable interior + read-only context buffer + external gateways
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Roads leaving the crop never silently become dead ends; gateways carry bounded simulated demand/capacity, not infinite sink/source.
tasks.notes: boundary.py classifies every road node as interior/buffer/outside and synthesizes a Gateway (namespace=simulation_assumption, explicit rule, bounded demand+capacity, never infinite) at each edge endpoint that leaves the AOI. See ADR-0007.

tasks.title: MapPack bake: immutable/versioned, provenance, quality report, OSM/ODbL notices
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Deterministic payload for the same source+settings; ships attribution/ODbL notice per ADR-0004; quality report lists unknowns/dropped/quarantined feature IDs with reasons.
tasks.notes: content_hash = sha256 of the canonical serialization of `payload` only; all timestamps live in a separate `volatile` section outside the hashed region (ADR-0006). Two independent `thaivia build` runs (>1s apart) produce an identical content_hash; a changed setting produces a different one. Attribution/ODbL notice + copyright URL embedded in provenance. JSON Schema committed at tools/map_pipeline/schemas/mappack.schema.json and validated on every bake and every verify.

tasks.title: Wire `thaivia build` and `thaivia audit` to the real pipeline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: `thaivia build` produces a real MapPack from an acquired source; `thaivia audit` regenerates docs/data/pilot-audit.md with real counts, replacing the not_measured placeholders.
tasks.notes: `thaivia build`/`thaivia audit`/`thaivia verify` are real, wired to the pipeline, and were exercised end to end (acquire --from-local-file -> build -> audit -> verify, all exit 0) against a synthetic fixture. `thaivia audit` with no --pack leaves the real placeholder untouched (exit NOT_IMPLEMENTED) instead of zero-filling fake numbers -- it has NOT been run against real source data because none has been acquired yet (see G1-10/ADR-0003).

tasks.title: Real docs/data/pilot-audit.md for th-bkk-pilot-001
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reports real source snapshot/hash, feature inventory, known/unknown attributes, topology conflicts, retained/rejected counts, and a real usability verdict for the crop.
tasks.blocker: Every configured OSM source endpoint remains blocked by organization egress policy (see docs/decisions/0003). The pipeline that would produce this document is fully implemented and tested (see G1-01..G1-09); only a real acquired source is missing. docs/data/pilot-audit.md is deliberately left as the honest blocked/not_measured placeholder -- a sample of what `thaivia audit` renders from a SYNTHETIC fixture (never to be confused with this) is saved at docs/evidence/g1-synthetic-e2e-audit-sample.md.

tasks.title: Pipeline correctness tests per plan's test list (lon/lat round-trip, grade separation, oneway=-1/turn restrictions, holes/multipart, source-gap-not-empty-space, buffered crop, deterministic pack, unknown-fields-stay-unknown)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each listed invariant has a passing pytest test, runnable against both synthetic fixtures and (once available) the real pilot extract.
tasks.notes: All 9 spec-mandated cases plus assumption-namespace isolation and hostile/degenerate input handling have passing pytest tests (67 passed total, up from 17 at G0). Tests run against synthetic fixtures only, as documented -- per ADR-0003/AGENTS.md this does NOT pass the real-data gate; that is G1-10, still blocked.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: By default reports source reachability from configs/sources.json's recorded_status, labelled as cached; --probe-network opts into the old live-probe behavior.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: A clean Unity 6.3 LTS project (patch chosen after checking official docs on a machine that has Unity) opens and builds; no fabricated ProjectVersion.txt/package lock.

tasks.title: Unity MapPack loader (C#)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Loads a local MapPack, validates its manifest hash/schema, exposes GeographyBase/SimulationInitialization/PlayerDelta as separate structures.
tasks.blocker: The loader LOGIC is done and tested outside Unity (see W3-01): Thaivia.Core.Serialization.MapPackLoader loads a MapPack, validates manifest schema/importer version, recomputes and compares content_hash, and exposes GeographyBase/SimulationInitialization as separate immutable types (PlayerDelta/WorldState are separate types in Thaivia.Core.Simulation, not yet wired to any MapPack field -- G3 scope). What remains blocked is the Unity side specifically: game/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MapPackLoaderBehaviour.cs (a thin MonoBehaviour wrapper around the same loader) is written but has never been compiled or run, because G2-01 (an actual Unity project) is still blocked on a licensed Editor.

tasks.title: Viewer rendering: top-down + oblique of the same geometry, roads/buildings/water/bridges, no grid-snapping
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Same source geometry renders correctly from both camera angles; grade separation stays visually distinct.
tasks.notes: Written (uncompiled): game/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Rendering/{Road,Building,Water}MeshBuilder.cs and Camera/OrthoObliqueCameraRig.cs -- one orthographic camera switches pitch between top-down and oblique over the same built meshes, so there is no separate oblique-only geometry to drift out of sync. Grade separation comes from RoadEdge.Layer (a semantic ordering, never metres, per Thaivia.Core's own contract) times a fixed visual step. Still blocked: never compiled or visually verified (needs G2-01).

tasks.title: Viewer interaction: pan/pinch, feature selection, source/unknown/assumption inspector
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Selection never mutates geometry; inspector clearly separates real source tags from unknown/assumed values.

Still blocked: never compiled or run (needs G2-01/G2-03).

tasks.title: Pure C# simulation core scaffold (no UnityEngine dependency), testable via dotnet test
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A .csproj compiles and its tests run with `dotnet test` using the container-local .NET SDK; the core never imports UnityEngine.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core (game/Thaivia.Core.csproj, source under game/Assets/Scripts/Core/) compiles with `dotnet build` (0 warnings, 0 errors) and is exercised by game/Thaivia.Core.Tests via `dotnet test`: 35 passed (see docs/evidence/g2-dotnet-build.log, g2-dotnet-test.log). Covers the MapPack contract types, a strict loader/validator with content_hash re-derivation and schema/importer version checks, SourceValue<T> (Known/Unknown/Assumed), GeographyBase immutability (get-only properties + a reflection test), Simulation.PlayerDelta/WorldState kept structurally separate from GeographyBase/SimulationInitialization, float64->float32 coordinate narrowing with measured error, and RoadGraphIndex traversal (node-id-only adjacency, oneway incl. reversed, turn restrictions incl. unsupported). UnityEngine-freedom is enforced by the project having no UnityEngine reference at all (not just by convention), by Thaivia.Core.asmdef's noEngineReferences=true, and by a source-scan test (NoUnityEngineReferenceTests). See ADR-0008/0009/0010.

tasks.title: Deterministic world & tick: fixed logical clock (no wall-clock catch-up), named independent PRNG streams, WorldRevision counter
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Same seed + same committed command sequence produces a bit-identical structural world hash; drawing from one named RNG stream never shifts another's position; resuming after a paused clock adds zero ticks on its own.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Time.{TickConfig,SimClock} (5Hz constant, AdvanceTicks-only clock, Resume() takes no wall-clock parameter at all); Thaivia.Core.Simulation.RandomStreams.{DeterministicRandom,NamedRandomStreams} (splitmix64, one independent object per named stream). WorldState.Revision incremented only by PlanningEngine's commit methods. Verified by SimClockTests (incl. a source-scan control test proving the wall-clock-detector itself is not a no-op, mirroring NoUnityEngineReferenceTests' standard), NamedRandomStreamsTests (incl. DrawingFromOneStream_DoesNotShiftAnotherStreamsSequence), WorldStateDeterminismTests (two independently built WorldStates, same seed+commands, identical ComputeStructuralHash()).

tasks.title: SimulationInitialization seeding from a loaded MapPack + a ScenarioConfig: household/cohort records, never per-agent population truth
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Population is stored as household/cohort counts; any renderer-facing agent/sprite sample count is derived on demand and never feeds back into the population total; SimulationInitialization/GeographyBase share no type with the new simulation-layer types.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Scenario.ScenarioConfig (the 'scenario config' the spec requires alongside simulation_initialization.seed, which the G1/G2 pipeline still bakes as {} -- documented honestly, not pretended). Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Cohorts.HouseholdCohort: PopulationCount = HouseholdCount * PeoplePerHousehold is the only source of population truth; SampleAgentCount(cap) is a derived method, never a stored field. WorldState seeds cohorts/BuildingSimState from GeographyBase.Buildings' centroids + a deterministic (non-RNG) archetype hash. Verified by LayerSeparationTests (reflection: no Simulation-namespace type is assignable to/from any MapPack-namespace type) and SimulationFixturesTests.

tasks.title: 6-8 building/activity archetypes with an hourly activity clock; ethical constraint (no archetype is inherently a problem) enforced in comments/tests
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Impact depends on activity x time x location (same archetype quiet at one hour, loud at another); Temple/community archetypes never carry a permanently elevated score; no archetype is wired to a real named place.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Archetypes.BuildingArchetype (8 generic archetypes) + ActivityClockCatalog (per-archetype 24h profile from a named peak-window shape, not a flat hand-typed table). Verified by ActivityClockCatalogTests, incl. an explicit ethical-constraint regression test (Temple_IsCalmAcrossMostOfTheDay_NeverPermanentlyElevated) and LateNightFoodStreet_IsLouderAtNightThanEarlyMorning proving the activity x time dependency.

tasks.title: Noise index (0-100, of the game) + accessibility computed over the road graph (never a straight-line radius) + cohort needs (sleep/access/safety/economy)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A deliberately adversarial fixture (two road-graph nodes 2m apart in straight-line space but on unconnected clusters, i.e. opposite banks of a canal) shows accessibility reflects the network, not the distance.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Noise.NoiseIndex (distance-decay + hourly activity, explicitly documented as a game index, not dB). Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Accessibility.AccessibilityGraph (Dijkstra over RoadGraph node-id adjacency only, exactly like Thaivia.Core.Graph.RoadGraphIndex's discipline) + AccessibilityNeed (0-100 score, null distance scores 0, never 'fine'). The single most scrutinised test per the supervising engineer's brief: AccessibilityGraphTests.StraightLineNearNodes_WithNoConnectingEdge_AreGraphUnreachable and EndToEndAcrossDisconnectedClusters_IsUnreachable_DespiteShortStraightLinePath. See ADR-0015.

tasks.title: Money & Planning Mode: integer ledger (recurring/opex/capex/non-recurring), reserve-then-pay-milestones, transactional commit, idempotent re-confirm
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Money is integer everywhere (reflection-checked); available = cash - reserved; accepting then paying never double-charges; confirming the same draft twice never deducts twice; commit revalidates geometry/conflicts/budget as one transaction with a proven partial-failure rollback case; estimating a draft touches neither the RNG nor the world.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Economy.MoneyLedger + Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Planning.{ProjectDraft,CommittedProject,PlanningEngine}. Verified by MoneyLedgerTests (incl. a reflection test that no public member uses float/double/decimal) and PlanningEngineTests: Estimate_DoesNotMutateTheWorld_HashAndEveryRngStreamUnchanged, ConfirmingTheSameDraftTwice_DoesNotDeductBudgetTwice, AcceptingThenPayingMilestones_NeverDoubleCharges_..., CommitRelocation_InsufficientBudget_AppliesNothing_TransactionalRollback, CommitRelocation_GeometryConflict_..._AppliesNothing_EvenWithSufficientBudget. See ADR-0013.

tasks.title: Building relocation as a project: destination geometry + cost + occupants/jobs transferred (not deleted) + old-location treatment; no free teleport; GeographyBase stays untouched
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Total population and jobs conserved across a move; accessibility changes as a result; GeographyBase reference/content byte-identical before and after; a VacatedLot record captures old-location treatment.
tasks.notes: PlanningEngine.CommitRelocation applies the move to Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Buildings.BuildingSimState (immutable-replace, source id/jobs count never change) and records a VacatedLot; GeographyBase is never touched (no mutation API exists on it at all -- see ImmutabilityTests). Verified by PlanningEngineTests.Relocation_ConservesPopulationAndJobs_AndDoesNotMutateGeographyBase and Relocation_ImprovesAccessibility_WhenMovingIntoTheConnectedCluster.

tasks.title: Save/Load: mapId/mapVersion + hash + simulation/content version + mutable state + PlayerDelta-derived state + RNG stream positions; latest/previous with corrupt fallback; explicit map-version-mismatch rejection; round-trip identity
tasks.acceptance_criteria: save -> load -> continue N ticks produces the identical world hash as never having saved; a save whose mapId/mapContentHash does not match the installed MapPack is rejected explicitly, not partially loaded; a corrupt 'latest' slot falls back to 'previous' and says so.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Simulation.Save.{SaveGame,SaveSerializer,SaveGameStore,LoadResult}. The second most scrutinised test per the supervising engineer's brief: SaveLoadTests.SaveThenRestore_ThenContinue_ProducesTheIdenticalHashAsNeverHavingSaved. Also: Store_LoadLatest_MapVersionMismatch_IsRejectedExplicitly_NotPartiallyLoaded, Store_CorruptLatest_FallsBackToPrevious_AndSaysSo, Store_BothSlotsCorrupt_ReturnsCorrupt_NeverAPartialLoad. See ADR-0014.

tasks.title: G3 gate: at least two genuinely different, measured solutions to the seeded noise/access problem
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Two distinct command sequences (building relocation vs a new road connector) each measurably improve the same accessibility metric, with the improvement measured and printed, not merely asserted > 0.
tasks.notes: TwoSolutionsIntegrationTests. Baseline accessibility score for the seeded residential cohort's home building is 0 (genuinely unsolved -- opposite side of the fixture's canal from the only job-bearing building). Solution 1 (relocate the residential building into the connected job cluster): 0 -> 98. Solution 2 (commit a new road connector bridging the two clusters, building never moves): 0 -> 94. Both measured via WorldState.ComputeAccessibilityScore and printed to test output (docs/evidence/g3-two-solutions-measured.log), not tuned to make 'two ways exist' trivially true -- both use the exact same AccessibilityGraph/AccessibilityNeed machinery every other test exercises.

tasks.title: ADR owed from the G2 wave: the disclosed temporary rule for TurnDecision.Unsupported in gameplay routing
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A real, tested policy type decides what gameplay routing does with TurnDecision.Unsupported (not left implicit in docs/progress.md prose), documented as an ADR per spec's explicit requirement.
tasks.notes: Thaivia.Core.Graph.GameplayTurnPolicy.IsAllowedForGameplayRouting: Unsupported is treated exactly like Denied (fail-safe, not fail-open). Verified by GameplayTurnPolicyTests. See ADR-0016.
